remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 1-bedroom condo offering comfortable living and flexible space in a highly convenient Stamford location. Inside, you'll find a clean, updated kitchen and a refreshed full bath. The layout includes a versatile extra area that can easily serve as a home office, guest room, or potential second bedroom. The living space feels open and inviting, with plenty of natural light and hardwood floors  Woodside Green is a beautifully maintained community, where residents enjoy landscaped grounds and a charming gazebo - a peaceful place to unwind outdoors. All this just moments from the thriving downtown area of Stamford, and a short distance to Starbucks, grocery shopping, and convenient bus lines. A wonderful opportunity for anyone seeking low-maintenance living in a vibrant, commuter-friendly location, or investment opportunity.
